notes.title: 🎵 Update Announcement: 10 New Songs Added
notes.notes:
Dear players,

Thank you so much for the love and support you've shown for GridFiller.
What started as a small puzzle game has become something more meaningful — a quiet space that many of you turn to for a moment of calm in your busy lives. That means the world to us.

To make that space a little warmer, we've added 10 new music tracks to the game.
These songs are gentle, reflective, and designed to accompany your journey — whether you're solving puzzles, unwinding after a long day, or simply letting your mind wander.

We hope they help you slow down, breathe, and enjoy the quiet in between the noise.

Thank you for playing,
— The GridFiller Team

notes.title: GridFiller - Game Release Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are excited to announce that GridFiller will officially launch in 2 days! 🎉🧩

After months of development, we are thrilled to bring this unique puzzle experience to you. GridFiller is a modern take on the classic tangram puzzles, with 200 handcrafted levels to test your logic, creativity, and spatial reasoning. Whether you're a casual player or a hardcore puzzle enthusiast, we’ve designed something for everyone.

Key Features:
200+ Handcrafted Levels: Dive into an array of puzzles, from beginner-friendly to mind-bending challenges!
Colorful, Minimalist Design: Enjoy a soothing and modern aesthetic while solving puzzles.
Relaxing Soundtrack: Chill with a lo-fi soundtrack that keeps you focused.
Replayability: Perfect your solutions and aim for the best completion times.
More levels are coming soon! We’ll be adding more levels in future updates, so there’s always something new to look forward to!

If you haven’t added it to your wishlist yet, now’s the perfect time to do so! 🚀

Thank you for all your support during development. We can’t wait to see you solving grids with us!
